dynamicTools.description: Tools provided by the Quokka Code runner.

tools.name: secret_word
tools.description: Returns the current secret word for this thread. The word can change, so call this every time you need it; never reuse an earlier answer.

input.text: Do two things. 1) Run the shell command `sh ./envcheck.sh`. 2) Call the quokkacode secret_word tool. Then reply with the script output, followed by the secret word.
